## History

Flora Jane is mentioned as one of Mrs. Blewett's children. Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) notes that Flora Jane is small and not much help, using this to argue that she needs a girl like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to assist her with her large family.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. ## Relationships

### [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Flora Jane is the child of Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md). Her mother visits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when they are attempting to resolve a mix-up regarding Anne's adoption.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), +2 more_
